race.comment: CURRUMBIN ALLEY (4) did get out to a staying trip when last in work so that is worth noting. However he did show plenty of toe to begin the campaign. Should never be far away off the inside draw. Probably would love a little give in the ground. AMARONE (9) will be a contender given how he finished last prep. He too was capable of racing on the pace. Should finish this race off nicely. ODE SO MUCH (8) has to be considered given he will sit around the pace of the race and has had the run back. He could be dangerous on the map. FLAMBOYANT LAD (1) does run well at the course. Coming back in ground a slight concern.
